environment.description: Go microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) as a Deployment in namespace 'platform-services'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects exist in the namespace. Node IAM role has 's3:*' and 'sts:AssumeRole' permissions. IMDSv1 is enabled on the EC2 instances (HttpTokens: optional). The service is exposed internally via ClusterIP service on port 8080.
